title: How to Grow Your Pilates Business - Marketing 360® Blog

facts.fact: Marketing 360 advises that Pilates studios should expect at least half of their website traffic to come from phones.
facts.quote: Expect at least half your traffic to come from phones.

facts.fact: Marketing 360 states that with diligence a Pilates business can show up in three places on page one of search results.
facts.quote: With diligence, you can show up in three places on page one.

facts.fact: Marketing 360 describes the Google My Business listing as a free listing that can be optimized with descriptions and customer reviews.
facts.quote: It’s a free listing you can optimize with your descriptions and by getting customer reviews.

facts.fact: Marketing 360 states that the social media platforms Pilates studios use are free to use, so the main cost is the time to create and post content.
facts.quote: The platforms are all free to use, so it’s just a matter of taking the time to create and post the content.

facts.fact: The page was originally published on October 15, 2018.
